radar.scoreMeaning: V4.4 candidateQuality, timingScore, entrySignal and runner fields are preserved. executionScore is a non-probability execution-quality score with one vote per input family. radar.priceWindowBasis: Completed 5M candles; exact 1/3/12-bar returns and completed-bar volume.
radar.flow5mBasis: Bybit 5min Open Interest aligned with completed 5M contract candles; used for Price×OI state transitions, CORRELATION_FLIP and REBUILD.
